audience: Shopify merchants who run loyalty, reviews and wishlists with Growave

useCases.title: Check the VIP tier of a customer
useCases.text: Find a customer by Shopify customer ID, email or phone. Read their tier and their progress to the next tier.

useCases.title: Review loyalty rules and rewards
useCases.text: Check which programs are enabled. List the earning rules and the rewards customers can redeem.

useCases.title: Read the reviews of one product
useCases.text: List reviews filtered by product or rating. Read the average rating and star breakdown of the product.

useCases.title: Review shopper questions about products
useCases.text: List product questions, filtered by product and publication state. Read them to find questions that need a reply.

useCases.title: See what a customer has earned and saved
useCases.text: Read a customer's points activity and the rewards they can use now. List their wishlists and the items in them.
